snippet.title: Lifeblood // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/796340/Lifeblood/

Action-Fantasy + Survival / Battle Royale centered around teamwork and team composition. Lifeblood provides fast-paced, skill oriented combat that thrives on intelligent plays, team cohesion and players ability to adapt to their combat environment.

Developed by
Homage Studios
- - -
Steam Store says "Early Access" but if you read the box it says the last update was 7 years ago. So be mindful if you plan to buy
